title: opportunities.json
description: The file the pipeline writes for the flexible opportunities page: when it was made, and every program with no set times. Each program follows docs/opportunity.schema.json. Kept apart from events.json, whose format does not change. Plain-language guide: docs/EVENT-FORMAT.md.

generated_at.description: When the pipeline wrote this file, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

opportunities.description: Every flexible opportunity. Ids must be unique; the pipeline and tests check this, because JSON Schema cannot.
